resolutions.researcher_notes: EIA's historical natural gas pipeline projects dataset (already cited on this row for Capacity/Diameter/Fuel/Location/Operator/SegmentCost/Start/Status) carries a dedicated 'FGT AE Cooperative Upgrade' row that also gives Miles = 0.2 for this project — the same document sources Length too, it just wasn't carried over when the sibling columns were filled. NOTE FOR ROUTING: this is NOT a rounding-tolerance match. The sheet records LengthKnown = 0.00 mi (the 'expansion with no new physical pipe' convention), but EIA's own figure for this exact project (matched on operator, docket CP00-40, cost, capacity, diameter and in-service year) states a nonzero 0.2 mi, i.e. EIA's source data implies a short new tie-in/lateral was built alongside the compression upgrade, not zero new pipe — a material discrepancy on the classification underlying LengthKnown=0, not just the number. Flagging as a validity/spec concern for Update to adjudicate (0.00 vs 0.2 mi); not changing the value in this refs-only pass. Searched for a second independent source: web searches for "AE Cooperative" + Florida Gas Transmission, "Alabama Electric Cooperative" (AE Cooperative's likely full name, later renamed PowerSouth Energy Cooperative in 2008) + FGT lateral, and the FERC Docket CP00-40 Phase V Expansion Federal Register notices (2000-08-31 supplemental NOI/EIS scoping notice and 2002-02-06 notice of amendment) — both notices describe the broader ~190-215 mile, multi-state Phase V program in aggregate and never break out or name an 'AE Cooperative' sub-project specifically, so they cannot serve as a second citation for this line item. No independent second source located; single-sourced to EIA pending further research.
